description: This file declares the Response class within the WebSockets::JsonRpc namespace, which represents a JSON-RPC response message. It provides methods to access ID, determine if the response is a result or error, and retrieve corresponding JSON objects. The class inherits from WPEFramework::Core::JSONRPC::Message.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A class representing a JSON-RPC response, providing methods to query response details such as ID, success/error status, and associated JSON data.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the response message.

methods.name: isResult
methods.description: Checks if the response is a successful result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result JSON object if available.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the response indicates an error.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the error JSON object if available.
